title: Safety Alignment Should Be Made More Than Just A Few Attention Heads
reasoning: The paper focuses on the mechanistic interpretability and technical robustness of LLM safety alignment against jailbreak attacks. While it evaluates the model's refusal of harmful or 'unethical' content (such as poisoning, fraud, or misinformation), it does so as a measure of safety filter engineering rather than as an evaluation of religious beliefs, moral reasoning, or ethical philosophy.
